horoscopes.horoscope: An enterprising day. The stars say you may visit an ancient place. A museum, perhaps, or a historical place. But your health may require some attention, says Ganesha. If so, it’s a good idea to spend an evening by yourself. You will meet a happy-go-lucky person today, foresees Ganesha. Since you’re in a good mood, you would want to socialise with a group or a club. Someone from opposite sex will be attracted by your cheerful personality. When you meet them, you may say or do something for which they applaud you. Feeling low since morning, you may avoid going to office and just lie down in bed. However, Ganesha advises you to finish urgent work on hand, and thereafter spend rest of the day in the company of friends or family. You hardly stand a chance to earn extra penny through any source. Ganesha feels that you will not even be in a mood to put in efforts to earn extra money today, and will instead just want to relax. You will be professional and will focus completely on pending tasks. Thus, you will get ready to take up new challenges. Your fearlessness is the key to success. Your confidence, sincerity and determination will help you achieve some important projects in the office, says Ganesha.

You are likely to confront a turning point in relationships today, foresees Ganesha. Because you are in need of some compassion and support, you will feel the need to spend time with friends and relatives. Your beloved or better half may bring a change in mood by helping you shed your negative frame of mind, says Ganesha. You may plan to surprise your family and friends. So you may call up your friends and relatives and arrange a get-together. You will be appreciated for this invitation. You will love to see smile and joy in the face of others. You will celebrate this wonderful evening in a joyful mood. Ganesha says that you shall politely interact with one and all today. As a result, your colleagues, associates, friends, relatives and family will feel very glad. Your positive vibes will spread around, and they shall also behave nicely with you. You will just have to remain satisfied with what you are earning in regular course and that should put you at ease too. Putting in too much effort or devoting much time to anything else wouldn’t work in your favour. Keep your nerve cool under pressure today, warns Ganesha. You will be able to accomplish your tasks only if you are in a balanced state of mind. New opportunities will call upon you to use your presence of mind and transform thoughts into action.

Today, you will toil as if you have to conquer Mt. Everest. And you will, says Ganesha. You may not get a standing ovation or a medal of honour for your hard work and dedication, but you will be lavishly appreciated by your superiors and colleagues. The task will require a lot of character and even a few changes in your disposition, but you will do this with ease. An innocent rendezvous with your beloved may turn into a sizzling adventure only if you make the right moves! Just open up to make yourself feel comfortable in front of your sweetheart. You can also please him or her by singing the favourite romantic number from your heart, suggests Ganesha. You are going to enjoy both good health and mood today. You may not be very energetic but you will be feeling more settled and at ease. Your work performance will be good. You may also wish to eat something of your choice today. You shall come across new opportunities to earn more money today. You get more business, find a new job or negotiate your salary to get a better deal. Use your funds sparingly to save more. A technical task will definitely confuse you today. Let it be else you may end up losing yourself in the maze. Finishing off something simple would be a clever idea, suggests Ganesha. You will get the things done if you work for the sake of pleasure, fun or excitement, assures Ganesha.

The day shall find you in buoyant spirits, indicates Ganesha. As you are feeling lively and full of beans, you will not mind slogging it out, even if in some mindless activities or chores. It is a perfect day for activities like gardening, cooking, baking and even for a nice house warming get-together. Evening stars encourage you to go all out and splurge – emotion-wise, money-wise or time-wise – on your sweetheart!. Congratulations! An overdose of kisses and hugs may come your way. Your sweetheart will be impressed by your willingness to compromise on issues that were a thorn in the neck till yesterday. Talk to your partner so as to make him/her feel glad, suggests Ganesha. You may not be able to command today but you will do well if you just ‘follow’. You could as well feel increased anxiety about things going wrong. Keep your anxiety level in control, otherwise your health and humour both will be affected. If someone offers you a very good business or shows you plan to double your money in a very short time – do not trust the person or that scheme without doing your own research. Ganesha has already planned a fantastic day for you. Your mind is likely to be tension free and focused. Heavy workloads will not bother you at all. You will achieve your targets easily at work, without missing a single clue, foresees Ganesha.

The trader in you comes to the fore today. With an impeccable eye for recognising profitable avenues, you will quickly spot opportunities that arise from buying goods at cheaper prices, and selling them off at a rate that leaves you with a lump sum profit. Start with small transactions, and treat each transaction with care before you plunge into bigger ventures, like the Bull-n-Bear tussle of stock markets. Ganesha wishes you all the success today. You’ll forget all your worries at the sight of your lover, which will send your adrenaline rushing. Gear up for some love and feeling. When it comes to romance, you want to see your lover’s adventure spirit. Your wild mind is likely to stimulate your sweetheart’s fantasy, feels Ganesha. Ganesha feels that you should keep all the worries aside and stay focussed on what you ‘have’ to do. Instead of getting stressed, believe in yourself and your efforts. You could experience health problems today, so you should better beware. You shall be averse to buy anything of an inferior quality today, and you shall aim to purchase only the high end things in your quest for perfection. You may want to invest money in maintaining your house. A great day awaits you! If you aren’t satisfied with your salary, which hasn’t budged in the past few years, then it’s time to voice your concern to your boss or HR head. Important meetings are also on the cards, says Ganesha.

You will be in a very ambitious and conscientious mood today. Your actions will speak louder than words. You set the pace with your meticulous planning and careful execution. Ganesha says you may expect a lot of appreciation and recognition for your work coming from your boss and your colleagues. You need to come close to your sweetheart to understand his/her feelings, foresees Ganesha. You will be able to find a better solution of issues by yourself. Be kind, sympathetic and trustworthy with your loved one and you will discover true love and enjoy a romantic life. You will carry on the entire day with greater enthusiasm. Your energy level will hardly drop today. Towards end of the day, you will be in a mood to relax, meet friends or enjoy good time with those who adore you. If your budget permits it, you will buy it – or else, you will wait for your financial situation to improve. No one will be able to provoke you to spend money without any logic. You will have a satisfactory day at work today, foresees Ganesha. Your amicable attitude will promise healthy relationships with peers and this will certainly add to your productivity. Moreover, you are brimming with optimism. Decision making will give you sheer confidence.

Ganesha says today is a day where you will spend happy moments with your family members. You will feel happy and will get to spend some romantic time with your beloved. Your innermost feeling will be showcased in the internal thoughts of your life partner and both of you will be in tandem with each other today. Ganesha advises you to enjoy these pleasant moments of togetherness. Everything may not be hunky dory in your personal life. A disagreement with your partner may affect your relationship, foresees Ganesha. You may get deviated from a certain factor but you need to sort out the problem by yourself, says Ganesha. You will be full of energy today and you will use this energy properly. Your positive energy will help lead tasks to important points. Despite remaining active and busy today, you may not face any health issues. Your work output will be good. Ganesha advises you to maintain a good rapport with superiors in other organizations. People in authority can really be very helpful in finding you some good opportunities earn more money. Creativity is your passion, whereas language and communication are your power. You will be armed with the best use of these two important elements. You will greatly impress your colleagues and superiors with your creative inputs. This will certainly add brownie points to your image in the company.

You will spend most of the day in self-introspection and in testing your capabilities. You will take all the needed steps to improve your professional proficiency. Your rare insight and gifted understanding of human nature will prepare you for leadership in the near future, hopes Ganesha. With things moving at a normal pace, harmony should prevail in your love life, foresees Ganesha. You will feel safe and comfortable in the arms of your lover. With long-term commitment on the cards, you will be having a positive period, foresees Ganesha. You will have lot of energy today. You are suggested not to plan your day. Rather you should let it be and react as per the circumstances. Health wise, you have a good day on hand, so it has to be utilized properly. Ganesha feels that you will be lucky in financial matters today. Your decisions regarding finances will be very firm and you shall be very rigid on them once you have taken the decisions. Avoid getting too emotional about work today. Ganesha advises you to maintain a professional distance and view projects objectively. You don’t need to feel disappointed even though you aren’t able to work efficiently as Ganesha feels that it’s just a passing phase.

Whatever you take up today, you are on a winning spree, foresees Ganesha. A a leader, you will guide and instruct your subordinates when they seek your advise. In a way, you even encourage and motivate them. All in all, you are a happy soul at the end of the day!. It’s caution and tact that will help you sail smoothly on the personal front. Ganesha feels that it’s your generosity that adds value to your love life. Your honest and truthful nature will come to the fore. You are in a mood to compromise in your love relationship. As far as possible, do not argue with anyone in your workplace and residence today. This could lead to disputes and disturb the work or home atmosphere, foresees Ganesha. Moreover, your energy level may decrease and adversely affect your health. You are advised to remain composed about your current financial condition and hope for the improvement in the future. Until you learn to control expenses, you won’t have peace of mind. Considering the number of files pending in your computer, Ganesha suggests it’s the time to pull up your socks and get down to work. However, taking breaks at intervals will keep your mind stress-free. Spending time with superiors and colleagues and planning work styles will reduce your stress.

Often, sentiments take over your mind. Making you impractical, at times, this tendency proves to be harmful for you. Don’t show it on your face as others may take advantage of your weakness, advises Ganesha. If you don’t control your emotions, it may become an obstacle in your path to success. Be strong and give a tough fight to those who want to go ahead of you. If you are still unhappy and feel that some negative factors are haunting you, listen to Michael Jackson’s “Hold my hand” with your soulmate. You will confidently be able to hold your hands with your darling and attract all emotional comforts and inner peace that nothing else can. From the beginning of this rather boring day, you shall find yourself in low spirits. Simple tasks may appear to be tough. Only attend urgent work, and do not undertake difficult tasks, else you may get tired very soon, observes Ganesha. Generally you are calculative when it comes to money matters, and you spend only after thinking many times. However, today, you are likely to be influenced by other people’s opinions and thoughts. This may be a stressful day for you, says Ganesha. It’s not just the physical stress but your emotion may also play havoc. There will be huge responsibilities and your boss will expect a lot from you. Keep your nerve cool under pressure and avoid getting hot-tempered over trivial matters, advises Ganesha.

You plot and plan well today! A lot of your time, energy and money may go into less productive activities. But the quality of your work will near perfection. Keep it up, says Ganesha, it is this creativity which gives you an edge over others. Lucky Colour Deep Electric Blue Your chilled out personality may not be appreciated by your partner. Therefore, you need to be a little more caring and sensitive to your sweetheart, feels Ganesha. One thoughtless remark may leave lasting scars. As responsibilities are on the cards, you tend to feel together, foresees Ganesha. As today you are going to be very busy, so Ganesha suggests you to be bit more careful about health. You may need to pay attention to many things at once, which may keep your brain cells active all the time. Ganesha feels that today the planets indicate routine expenses and routine income. No fluctuations are foreseen on the financial front. If you have taken loans in the past, you may try to finish them off ASAP. You are hungry for knowledge and fired up to learn new techniques, and today’s the right day for that. Go ahead and pursue a course if you wish. Ganesha says it is an investment that will pay off in the long run. Your creativity will boost your productivity.

Today your intellectual streak comes to the fore. You will indulge your curiosity and take interest in natural phenomenon. Your faith will help you complete all your pending tasks with ease. You will leave things to destiny. You will be more inclined to intellectual pursuits rather than professional, however, do not neglect your responsibilities, says Ganesha. A wonderful time is on the cards for the lovers. If you are single and in love, then this is an excellent day to propose that scintillating someone. With romance in the air, married ones will find pleasure in their partner’s company. On this wonderful day, expect your health to be on the positive side. Moreover, your creative abilities will come to the fore. You should preferably consume fresh fruit juices or health drinks daily to maintain your fitness level, advises Ganesha. Today, you will spend money like water on entertainment and pleasure. For you, it will be very important to be happy at heart and there may not be logical thoughts behind your purchases or expenses. You are in a mood to advise others but you may not feel confident enough. Ganesha feels that you need to hone your skills. This will also push you ahead on your path to professional success. You can achieve greater things by mixing your creative instincts with technical knowledge,
